item.title: KANSAS CANNABIS BILLS
item.description: Kansas House Democrats have bee punching two bills that would decriminalize cannabis, but it’s an uphill battle when it comes to Republican leadership. item.description: Following back-to-back weapon threats at Trojan Elementary School in Osawatomie, parents are asking for greater transparency from the school district. item.description: The Anderson County Detention Center used to be the premier facility in the area–when it was built in 2007. Other counties would regularly “farm out” their own overflow of inmates to Anderson County. However, the past couple years, that has pretty much stopped as new detention centers in the area have been built. Anderson County Commissioners are concerned about the cost of maintaining the jail.
